description: After rendering a video from a reference, check it against that film's measured timeline and get concrete fixes: cut timing to the frame, pace, brightness curve, motion per shot, loudness for the platform, and format. First measure your render: run `node scripts/measure.mjs <file>` from the Refs starter kit (curl -sL https://refs.video/starter.zip -o refs-starter.zip && unzip refs-starter.zip; it unpacks to refs-starter/) and pass the JSON it prints as `render`. Returns a score out of 100, a table of checks and a numbered fix list (frames at your render's frame rate), then the same as JSON. Costs 2 credits, so fix, re-measure and check again. Needs a Refs account with Pro; without one, the app asks the user to sign in. search_videos is free.

id.description: The reference you built from: REF-0005, a refs.video/v/… link, a YouTube/X link, or an id from search_videos

render.description: The JSON printed by `node scripts/measure.mjs <your video>`, as an object (or that JSON as text)

target.description: Where it will be posted; sets the loudness target: x, youtube, instagram and meta −14 LUFS, tiktok −14 to −10, web −16, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Default: the reference's platform

name: check_render
title: Check a render against its reference
